brief:
Israeli opposition leader Yair Lapid has accused supporters of Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu's government of attempting to undermine the country's democracy, according to Middle East Eye. He did not specify which policies or actions he was referencing.

The accusation underscores the deepening dispute between Netanyahu's coalition and opposition forces over judicial and institutional changes being pursued by the current government.
dek: Opposition leader Lapid accuses Netanyahu backers of attempts at 'crushing' Israel's democracy Israeli opposition leader Yair Lapid has accused supporters of Benajmin Netanyahu's government of attempting to "crush" Tel Aviv's democracy.
title: Lapid accuses Netanyahu supporters of attacking Israeli democracy
